evidence.observation: Monotonic pressure rise through growth from 2.92 to 3.19 Torr (k=20-26) while Ar flow and setpoints are constant
Flow steady at ~100 sccm, so the pressure rise is not a flow change
Thermocouple tracks 750 °C setpoint with plausible heater power ~45%
Sensor not installed; telemetry null, so atmosphere/air ingress cannot be verified

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 (or RGA/leak-check) measurement is absent by hardware, so seal leak vs exhaust blockage cannot be separated from telemetry alone; a flow-off pressure-decay test or a step change in Ar setpoint (blockage → conductance-limited pressure scales with flow; leak → residual rise with flow off) would discriminate.
